title: Plant Pre-Start Inspection
name: Plant Pre-Start Inspection
description: Daily pre-start inspection for site plant and machinery covering safety devices, leaks, tyres/tracks, visibility, access, attachments and obvious defects before operation.

sections.title: GENERAL CONDITION
items: Tyres, wheels, tracks and undercarriage are in serviceable condition
No significant oil, fuel, coolant or hydraulic leaks are visible
Steps, handholds, cab and access points are clean and secure
Windows, mirrors and cameras provide adequate visibility
Bodywork, guards and covers are secure
Attachments, pins and locking devices are correctly fitted

sections.title: CONTROLS / WARNING DEVICES / SAFETY SYSTEMS
items: Brakes, steering and operational controls respond correctly
Horn, lights, beacons and alarms operate where fitted
Seat belt / restraint is available and serviceable
Reversing aids / cameras / proximity systems operate where fitted
Emergency stop / isolation controls are accessible and functional
Safety interlocks and guards operate correctly

sections.title: FLUIDS / DOCUMENTATION / WORK READINESS
items: Fuel / battery / fluid levels are adequate
Required inspection / examination / maintenance status is current
Operator information and load / capacity markings are legible where relevant
Work area and route are suitable for the plant
Any attachment or lifting accessory intended for use is suitable and inspected

fields.label: Inspection Result
options: RESTRICTIONS - use only with stated controls
